title: Friendship through Marionettes
content: Ricky Syers, a puppeteer in his 50s and Doris Diether, a community activist in her 80s, became friends. Ricky made puppet alter egos of each of them, and they perform together in New York parks.Link to video on YouTubeAnother video shows more behind the scenes views of making of his marionettes:Link to Vimeo video
